summary.text: Christopher Sessions is the Libertarian candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Howard Penny Jr. (R) and Democrat Kevin G. Thurman.
Ballotpedia lists him as a U.S. Army veteran who served from 1989 to 2017, and in a survey he said he retired as a sergeant major.

paragraphs.text: Sessions was born in Anchorage, Alaska, and earned a graduate degree from Franklin University in 2012, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Johnston County for five years, has identified with Libertarian values since 2002, and serves as treasurer of the Libertarian Party of Johnston and Harnett County.
Sessions ran for North Carolina State Senate District 10 in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent Benton Sawrey (R).
His three key campaign messages in the survey were marijuana legalization, limiting the governor's emergency authority, and reducing the regulatory burden of occupational licensing.
